heading: Additional remedies
lead: The rights and remedies provided by this chapter shall be in addition to any and all other rights and remedies that may exist at law or in equity.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective upon the expiration of two hundred and seventy days after Aug. 1, 1968, see section 1423 of Pub. L. 90–448, set out as a note under section 1701 of this title.
